subject: Day 1: The Model Matrix (Routing Reasoning, Workhorses, and Open Weights)
goal: Stop using one chat subscription for everything and route tasks across reasoning, fast workhorse, and private open-weight tiers.
body: Most teams overpay on routine tasks while under-specifying complex synthesis. Today takes 10 minutes: read Unlocked Lesson 1.1 to map your recurring workflows across Frontier Reasoning, High-Throughput Workhorse, Fast Subagent, and Private Open-Weight tiers based on cost per verified completed task at https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses/1-1-2026-ai-landscape-model-matrix.

subject: Day 2: Structured Intake Skills Over One-Line Prompts
goal: Eliminate generic guesses by making your workspace gather missing constraints before drafting.
body: Twelve-word chat prompts force models to invent 85% of your operating rules. Flip the workflow: build reusable SKILL.md folders and intake checklists that ask 3 to 5 targeted questions, capture unwritten team standards, and verify constraints before generating a draft. Explore the full syllabus at https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses.

subject: Day 3: Privacy Boundaries, Workspace Folders, and Scoped Permissions
goal: Classify Green, Amber, and Red company data across enterprise cloud, zero-retention APIs, and private rigs.
body: Saying 'we opted out of training' is only the start of AI governance. Learn when folder-based workspaces suffice, when legal, finance, or clinical workflows require zero-data-retention APIs or private open-weight nodes, and why outbound actions stay at Draft-First human sign-off.

subject: Day 4: Vertical AI Platforms vs. Connected In-House Workflows
goal: Separate durable category platforms from thin SaaS wrappers across Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Ops.
body: Before signing six disconnected department tools that cannot share company context, apply our 3-way Build-vs-Buy matrix: when mature vertical platforms earn their seat, when to build on an Agent OS, and how lightweight search, OCR, and webhook connectors replace wrapper bloat. Read Lesson 2.1 free at https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses/2-1-vertical-ai-build-vs-buy-framework.

subject: Day 5: Next Steps Across the Lab, Team Workshops, and Bespoke Builds
goal: Put the 4-layer architecture into daily operation solo, across your team, or alongside us.
body: You now have the architectural spine behind dependable AI workflows: portable context, right-sized model routing, deterministic checks, and human sign-off gates. Explore the Agentic Architect Lab tracks at https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses, or inquire about team workshops and bespoke systems at https://agenticarchitect.ai/work-with-me.
